sn22.47:2.2: From here the discourse alludes to dependent origination. The sense faculties are “conceived”, i.e. “take rebirth”, like name and form ([sn12.39:1.4]()) or consciousness ([sn12.59:1.2]()) or an embryo ([mn93:18.61]()).
sn22.47:2.4: The “mind” (_mano_) in the presence of “ignorance” makes choices that drive the cycle ([sn12.25:10.3]()). Here _mano_, as usual, signifies the active volitional dimension of mind, while ignorance is shown to be not self-existent, but part of the complex of mental activity.
sn22.47:2.5: Through “contact” and “feeling” there arises the “grasping” of views of self.
sn22.47:2.6: See Uddālaka’s, “I am that, I indeed am that” (_iyam aham asmīyam aham asmīti_, Chāndogya Upaniṣad 6.10.1) and “I am” (_ahamasmi_) at Sāman Veda 594.
sn22.47:3.1: This is the one who ends the cycle.
